item.tib: rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyi tshe sgrub rgyun khyer nyungs 'dus
item.coloph: ces pa'i rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyi tshe sgrub rgyun 'khyer bde ba'i lam bzang 'di yang dad ldan snying slob rnam rgyal phun tshogs lags nas bskur (bskul) ba la brten/ shes (shel) skyes g.yung drung thog med du 'bod pa des/ shar grol smin gling du 'phral du spel ba 'dis kyang 'gro rnams tshe dang ye shes kyi lam bsgrod nas 'chi med skyes nas btsan pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
